# PlanWell Financial Planning
> Fee-based retirement planning exclusively for federal employees. Free FERS and TSP workshops have educated over 10,000 federal workers.

## About
PlanWell Financial Planning specializes in FERS retirement planning for federal employees. Founded by Certified Financial Planners (CFP®) and Chartered Federal Employee Benefits Consultants (ChFEBC℠). We offer free educational workshops and fee-based comprehensive planning.

## Free Workshops
- FERS Retirement Workshop (3 hours): /federal-retirement-webinars
- TSP Investment Workshop (1 hour): /webinar/tsp
- All workshops are free, virtual, and open to any federal employee
